svg.title: 11Be beta-delayed proton emission in Halo EFT
svg.desc: Figure 2 from Elkamhawy, Yang, Hammer, and Platter, Physics Letters B 821 (2021), 136610. Differential decay rates with and without resonant final-state interactions. The published plot, labels, legend, and uncertainty bands are unchanged.
